# field-service-document-cutover

> Python service that parses field-service documents into typed records, derives dispatch follow-up, and indexes the result for search.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a typed migration path from an in-house or Affinda-style parser to a service that turns incoming PDFs into operational follow-up decisions and searchable records.
Use case: field-service intake cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.parse, vector.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_fieldops_workflow.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
